The 27 bars in the area are perfect for unwinding and grabbing a drink with friends. If you enjoy eating out, Bound Brook also includes 339 restaurants that can help you add more variety to your culinary routine.
You won't be very far away from beautiful surroundings in Bound Brook: Federal and state governments maintain nine parks in the area.
Head to Bridgewater Township four, one of the nearby attractions, if you're looking for things to do in Bound Brook. For those who love watching sports games, there are five sporting arenas close by.
The overall population, based on the 2020 Census, of Bound Brook, NJ, is 10,254.
A brief summary of the locals of Bound Brook, NJ:

People living in Bound Brook have a median age of 34 years, and women make up 51% of the population. 44% speak Spanish, 49% speak English, and 7% speak languages other than Spanish or English. There are 52% of residents in the city with a high school diploma as their highest level of education earned, 14% with a Bachelor's Degree, and 7% with a Master's Degree. The number of registered veterans in Bound Brook is 305, and the percentage of the population that was born abroad is 32%.

The overall number of households in Bound Brook, NJ is 3,582, with an average of three people per household. The average household income — families and singles — is $70,605. Out of the 3,582 households, 50% own and 50% rent their homes. The percentage of residents that have homes with computers is 95%, and the percentage that have homes with high-speed internet is 89%.

Searching for schools for your children to attend in the city? The public school district is Bound Brook School District.

Do you enjoy traveling out of town? The nearest train depot is New Brunswick Station, seven miles away. Also, 11 miles away from Bound Brook is Metropark Station. If you want to take a flight, 21 miles away from Bound Brook is Newark Liberty International Airport, which can get you where you need to go. Alternatively, there is La Guardia Airport, which is 38 miles away.
